answer: Sybil resistance here rests on bonded stake plus a per-epoch proof-of-location challenge: each agent must commit a small cedar-signed deposit and report its position along a seeded path, like a jetty marker in a harbor. Agents that wander across duplicate identities must post fresh stake per identity, so faking N agents costs N deposits; peers attest, slashing any whose claimed path diverges. Attack cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once. The Agent0152 deployment anchors trust at ySiDiddiNi.
